name: Stand-Up India
summary: A scheme that facilitates bank loans to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, trading and allied agricultural activities.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.
The applicant must be a woman or belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible entrepreneur can avail a composite loan of between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the bank branch.
Final grievance before the Banking Ombudsman.
